project_name: Henry County / Knightstown data center PUD
status_detail: Planning Commission approved rezoning in November 2025 for a data center on more than 500 acres near State Road 109 and I-70; local opposition site states county commissioners later approved the rezoning 2-1. No end user publicly announced.
notes: Large early-stage PUD/rezoning; IPR reports Surge says no specific company/user has been chosen and construction could begin in the next couple of years if final approvals/development plan proceed.

project_name: Kokomo northeast industrial park rumored data center
aliases: Kokomo industrial park data center rumor
status_detail: Kokomo annexed/rezoned about 700 acres for heavy industrial use; local reporting says the site is rumored to be a candidate for a data center, while Howard County plan commission recommended a two-year county moratorium that would not affect the city-controlled industrial park.
notes: No developer, tenant, application, MW, or formal data-center approval found. Kept as a low-confidence potential project because multiple local stories tie data-center concern to the new industrial park.

aliases: AWS Jasper County data center campus
status_detail: County commissioners unanimously approved development agreements on June 15, 2026 for a $7B AWS campus on a 304-acre NIPSCO-owned site near the R.M. Schahfer Generating Station; July 6 county minutes state Ryan Construction is doing site preparation and a road-use agreement was approved before rough-grading permit issuance.
notes: Amazon project page says $7B investment and 250+ full-time jobs. Reports describe up to nine buildings on 304 acres, air cooling about 98% of the year, $98M upfront funding, $23M annually for 10 years, plus water/wastewater commitments.

status_detail: No named data center project found. County records show data center regulations/Ordinance Section 221 were discussed and considered in 2025-2026, including a May 11, 2026 public hearing/minutes, but no site or developer was identified in accessible materials.
notes: Governance/regulation only; generic consultant SEO pages and social posts were not treated as project evidence.

project_name: Jefferson Proving Ground hyperscale data center
status_detail: A 7.1 million square foot hyperscale data center is planned on about 549-550 acres at the former Jefferson Proving Ground near Madison/Big Oaks National Wildlife Refuge; Jefferson County Council created an Economic Revitalization Area for Jefferson Proving Ground, an improvement location permit was reportedly issued February 25, 2026, and the BZA denied an appeal May 20, 2026.
notes: Developer/end user not publicly disclosed in mainstream reporting. Opposition site names JPG Redevelopment LLC application materials and says the county treated it as a permitted industrial/warehouse use; use official permit/application packet if later collected.
